archetypes.name: White-Blue Spirits
archetypes.plan: Build around Feeling of Dread: Build an evasive Spirit force, use flashback and tap effects to control races, and attack through the air.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Zombies
archetypes.plan: Build around Forbidden Alchemy: Fill the graveyard and recur Zombies so removal trades become temporary setbacks rather than lost resources.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Vampires
archetypes.plan: Build around Rakish Heir: Pressure with Vampires, preserve attack triggers with removal, and snowball tribal bonuses across combat steps.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Werewolves
archetypes.plan: Build around Daybreak Ranger // Nightfall Predator: Develop Werewolves, pass selectively to transform them, and use instant-speed plays to keep the larger faces active.

archetypes.name: Green-White Humans
archetypes.plan: Build around Travel Preparations: Curve Humans into tribal or enter-the-battlefield bonuses, go wide, and attack with a strengthened team.

archetypes.name: White-Black Reanimator
archetypes.plan: Build around Unburial Rites: Stock the graveyard with valuable creatures, then return them to the battlefield for a mana and card advantage.

archetypes.name: Blue-Red Flashback
archetypes.plan: Build around Desperate Ravings: Fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries, cast them twice, and use the resulting card advantage to control combat.

archetypes.name: Black-Green Graveyard
archetypes.plan: Build around Spider Spawning: Trade creatures and mill selectively so graveyard payoffs turn spent cards into a late-game advantage.

archetypes.name: Red-White Aggro
archetypes.plan: Build around Rally the Peasants: Curve low-cost attackers into combat tricks and burn, widening the board enough to punish slow starts.

archetypes.name: Green-Blue Self-Mill
archetypes.plan: Build around Memory's Journey: Mill creatures and flashback cards deliberately, then turn graveyard volume into threats and card advantage.
